_doc: ElevenLabs sound-effect prompts for the proving grounds (concepts/sprites/arena/audio.js). Generate with tools/sfx/gen_sfx.py.
id: matches audio.js sound names (step.<surface>, hit.<material>, brk.<kind>, bed.<biome>.<time>, ...). Files: <id>_<n>.mp3.
dur: seconds (0.5-30, null = let the model pick). var: variants (played round-robin, so repeats don't machine-gun).
loop: seamless loop (beds, streams). infl: prompt_influence 0-1 (higher = more literal, less varied).
slice: one take holds SEVERAL hits (e.g. a run of footsteps); the loader splits it at onsets into a pool of one-shots.
gain: playback trim in dB applied by the loader after peak-normalising (fine mix stays in audio.js).
Prompt style: dry and close (audio.js adds its own per-biome reverb and distance filtering), no music, no voices,
one clear event per one-shot. Kept procedural (not listed): the bow DRAW creak (follows draw strength continuously).
